properties.statement: Every ESM document in canonical form reads back from its Markdown spelling.
properties.lean_statement: ∀ (d : Esm.Document.Json), Esm.Document.Source.canonDoc d = true → Esm.Document.Source.Md.parseMd (Esm.Document.Source.Md.printMd d) = some d

properties.statement: Every ESM document in canonical form reads back from its Typst spelling.
properties.lean_statement: ∀ (d : Esm.Document.Json), Esm.Document.Source.canonDoc d = true → Esm.Document.Source.Typ.parseTyp (Esm.Document.Source.Typ.printTyp d) = some d

properties.statement: The parse of a valid Markdown document depends only on its front matter and its sequence of constructs: not on the prose or code spans between them, nor on equation labels.
properties.lean_statement: ∀ (front : List (String × Esm.Document.Json)), Esm.Document.Math.jwf (.obj front) = true → ∀ (segs : List Esm.Document.Source.Md.Seg), Esm.Document.Source.Md.Valid true segs → Esm.Document.Source.Md.parseMd (String.ofList (Esm.Document.Source.Md.frontMd front ++ Esm.Document.Source.Md.render segs)) = Esm.Document.Source.Md.parseItemsMd front (Esm.Document.Source.Md.segItems segs)

properties.statement: Inserting prose into a valid Markdown document (keeping it valid) does not change its parse.
properties.lean_statement: ∀ (front : List (String × Esm.Document.Json)), Esm.Document.Math.jwf (.obj front) = true → ∀ (a b : List Esm.Document.Source.Md.Seg) (p : List Char), Esm.Document.Source.Md.Valid true (a ++ b) → Esm.Document.Source.Md.Valid true (a ++ .prose p :: b) → Esm.Document.Source.Md.parseMd (String.ofList (Esm.Document.Source.Md.frontMd front ++ Esm.Document.Source.Md.render (a ++ .prose p :: b))) = Esm.Document.Source.Md.parseMd (String.ofList (Esm.Document.Source.Md.frontMd front ++ Esm.Document.Source.Md.render (a ++ b)))

properties.statement: Adding an equation label to a valid Markdown document (keeping it valid) does not change its parse.
properties.lean_statement: ∀ (front : List (String × Esm.Document.Json)), Esm.Document.Math.jwf (.obj front) = true → ∀ (a b : List Esm.Document.Source.Md.Seg) (raw : String) (l : List Char), Esm.Document.Source.Md.Valid true (a ++ .item (.eqn raw) :: b) → Esm.Document.Source.Md.Valid true (a ++ .labeled raw l :: b) → Esm.Document.Source.Md.parseMd (String.ofList (Esm.Document.Source.Md.frontMd front ++ Esm.Document.Source.Md.render (a ++ .labeled raw l :: b))) = Esm.Document.Source.Md.parseMd (String.ofList (Esm.Document.Source.Md.frontMd front ++ Esm.Document.Source.Md.render (a ++ .item (.eqn raw) :: b)))

properties.statement: The parse of a valid Typst document depends only on its header and its sequence of constructs: not on the prose between them, nor on equation labels.
properties.lean_statement: ∀ (front : List (String × Esm.Document.Json)), (∀ a ∈ front, Esm.Document.Source.Typ.argOK a = true) → ∀ (segs : List Esm.Document.Source.Typ.Seg), Esm.Document.Source.Typ.Valid true segs → Esm.Document.Source.Typ.parseTyp (String.ofList (Esm.Document.Source.Typ.headerT front ++ Esm.Document.Source.Typ.render segs)) = Esm.Document.Source.Typ.parseItemsT front (Esm.Document.Source.Typ.segItems segs)

properties.statement: Inserting prose into a valid Typst document (keeping it valid) does not change its parse.
properties.lean_statement: ∀ (front : List (String × Esm.Document.Json)), (∀ a ∈ front, Esm.Document.Source.Typ.argOK a = true) → ∀ (a b : List Esm.Document.Source.Typ.Seg) (p : List Char), Esm.Document.Source.Typ.Valid true (a ++ b) → Esm.Document.Source.Typ.Valid true (a ++ .prose p :: b) → Esm.Document.Source.Typ.parseTyp (String.ofList (Esm.Document.Source.Typ.headerT front ++ Esm.Document.Source.Typ.render (a ++ .prose p :: b))) = Esm.Document.Source.Typ.parseTyp (String.ofList (Esm.Document.Source.Typ.headerT front ++ Esm.Document.Source.Typ.render (a ++ b)))

properties.statement: Adding an equation label to a valid Typst document (keeping it valid) does not change its parse.
properties.lean_statement: ∀ (front : List (String × Esm.Document.Json)), (∀ a ∈ front, Esm.Document.Source.Typ.argOK a = true) → ∀ (a b : List Esm.Document.Source.Typ.Seg) (raw : String) (l : List Char), Esm.Document.Source.Typ.Valid true (a ++ .item (.eqn raw) :: b) → Esm.Document.Source.Typ.Valid true (a ++ .labeled raw l :: b) → Esm.Document.Source.Typ.parseTyp (String.ofList (Esm.Document.Source.Typ.headerT front ++ Esm.Document.Source.Typ.render (a ++ .labeled raw l :: b))) = Esm.Document.Source.Typ.parseTyp (String.ofList (Esm.Document.Source.Typ.headerT front ++ Esm.Document.Source.Typ.render (a ++ .item (.eqn raw) :: b)))

properties.statement: Every expression reads back from its LaTeX spelling under the same symbol table.
properties.lean_statement: ∀ (S : Esm.Document.Math.Sym) (e : Esm.Document.Json), Esm.Document.Math.isE e = true → Esm.Document.Math.parseLatex S (Esm.Document.Math.printLatex S e) = some e

properties.statement: Every expression reads back from its Typst math spelling under the same symbol table.
properties.lean_statement: ∀ (S : Esm.Document.Math.Sym) (e : Esm.Document.Json), Esm.Document.Math.isE e = true → Esm.Document.Math.parseTypst S (Esm.Document.Math.printTypst S e) = some e
